subject: MAP: Paragon — Deployment path, region, and close timeline
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Erin Sullivan <erin.sullivan@paragonhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 27 May 2027 09:14:00 -07:00
Subject: MAP: Paragon — Deployment path, region, and close timeline

Hi Erin —

Thanks again for the conversation this morning. Per our MAP kickoff, I wanted to capture the proposed evaluation & close runway so we have alignment across teams. High level:

- Goal: Finalize deployment mode (Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private) and region selection to meet Paragon’s data residency & latency constraints, and reach contract signature.
- Proposed cadence:
  * Week 0–2: Hosted proof-of-concept (POC) — validate integration pattern, latency/throughput on representative traffic.
  * Week 3–6: Dedicated POC (reserved capacity) if you need predictable throughput or stricter isolation. Dedicated sizing exercise in Week 2 to lock GPU profile.
  * Parallel: Security/compliance intake (SOC 2 evidence, data flow diagrams) — target completion by Week 4.
  * Go/no-go decision target: Wednesday, 2027-06-23. Contract signature target: 2027-06-30 (procurement indicated month-end preference).

Key asks from Paragon this week:
1) Confirm primary region preference (US West vs US East vs EU West) and any hard data residency requirements.
2) Provide a small sample prompt set (redacted) and expected QPS/peak traffic so we can size the Dedicated POC.
3) Procurement point of contact + preferred contract timeline (DocuSign ok?).

Attachments: MAP_Paragon_v1.pdf (outline of milestones & owners). HubSpot deal link attached below.

I’ll loop in Lauren for pricing/sizing and Marissa for the security intake. Happy to jump on a quick sync if helpful.

Best,
Jordan
Senior Solutions Manager
Redwood Inference

---
Attachment: MAP_Paragon_v1.pdf (MAP summary, owners, target dates)
From: Erin Sullivan <erin.sullivan@paragonhealth.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Andrew Cho <andrew.cho@paragonhealth.com>, procurement@paragonhealth.com
Date: Fri, 28 May 2027 08:41:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: MAP: Paragon — Deployment path, region, and close timeline

Thanks Jordan — this is very helpful. Quick answers and questions below.

- Region: Primary requirement is US data residency with preference for US West (latency for our Pacific customers). EU region would only be for EU customer subset later in the year.
- Security: We need SOC 2 type II evidence and answers on data retention and tokenization for PII. Our security reviewer (Andrew) is copied.
- Traffic: For the POC we can start with a 10 qps steady-state simulation and a 60 qps short burst window — we’ll provide a sanitized prompt set by Monday.
- Procurement: Month-end target is realistic; procurement prefers DocuSign. Contact is procurement@paragonhealth.com.

A couple of asks for Redwood:
1) Can you confirm how quickly you can spin up Dedicated POC capacity in US West (estimate in days)?
2) For Hosted POC, what are the default retention/visibility rules for logs/inputs — we need assurances about not storing PHI.

If those timelines look good I’ll push internal stakeholders to meet the June 23 decision.

Thanks,
Erin
Director of Product
Paragon Health

Date: Mon, 31 May 2027 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: MAP: Paragon — Deployment path, region, and close timeline

Jordan — quick answers below; attaching a short pricing pack and SLO note.

1) Dedicated POC provisioning (US West): typically 5–7 business days for standard sizing. We can hit an accelerated 48–72 hour window if infrastructure warm pool is available; that requires ops sign-off and confirmed commitment to a minimum reserved profile.

2) Pricing (summary):
  - Hosted POC: pay-as-you-go, expected unit cost ~$0.024 per response-token (estimate depends on model family). No infra commitment; quick to start.
  - Dedicated POC (POC-tier reserved): ~$12k/week for a small GPU pool sized for ~10 qps steady / 60 qps burst (includes basic monitoring).
  - Production reserved (12-month commit): discounts available, typical markdown 18–28% depending on commit size.

3) Security notes for Hosted POC:
  - Default logs: request/response trace for 7 days. We offer a POC privacy toggle to disable persistent storage of user inputs and keep only hashed telemetry for performance metrics.
  - SOC 2 artifacts: available via our secure share (we will provide a temporary link for Paragon security review). Marissa will coordinate the evidence package.

Attachments: paragon_pricing_options.xlsx, slo_commit.md

Let me know if you want a detailed cost estimate for a specific model (we assume a 70B quantized profile for the POC here).

Thanks,
Lauren
Head of Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

Hi Erin —

Appreciate the quick answers. Per the internal responses above, here is an updated MAP action set & timeline:

- Week 0 (now) — Hosted POC start (US West). Redwood to enable privacy toggle for inputs; logs retention set to 7 days.
- Week 1–2 — Measure latency/quality on your sanitized prompt set (Jordan to coordinate test harness).
- Week 2 — Dedicated sizing call with Redwood infra (target: 2027-06-09) to confirm GPU profile and whether accelerated provisioning is required.
- Week 3–6 — Dedicated POC (if Paragon opts in). Cost estimate for Dedicated POC: ~$12k/week for the small pool sizing; production reserved pricing available with a 12-month commit.
- Security: Marissa to share SOC 2 evidence link and answers on tokenization and retention by 2027-06-08.
- Decision point: 2027-06-23 (go/no-go). Contract signature target: 2027-06-30 via DocuSign.

Next steps for Paragon: please confirm the following by COB Friday, 2027-06-04 so we can keep the June cadence:
1) Confirm go/no-go date is acceptable.
2) Share sanitized prompt set and the procurement POC contact.
3) Indicate whether you want Redwood to provision Dedicated POC automatically at Week 3 if initial Hosted results meet performance thresholds, or whether Paragon will explicitly request it.

Links and artifacts:
- HubSpot deal: https://hubspot.redwood/deal/PAR-2027-031
- MAP draft (for signature): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1ParagonMAP
- DocuSign signature envelope will be shared when Paragon confirms go/no-go.

I’ve attached an updated MAP bundle (MAP_Paragon_Final.docx) and the pricing pack Lauren shared. Happy to hop on a 30-minute alignment if helpful.

Best,
Jordan
